$description: Dark mode. Maps semantic colors to palette steps. Raised surfaces get lighter, not darker.

bg.$description: Backgrounds. Canvas is the page; surface is anything that sits on it; overlay is for floating layers.

sunken.$description: Wells: recessed tracks, table headers, code, count chips, disabled fields. Darker than the canvas, so a recess reads below the page.

field-disabled.$description: Disabled TextField, Select and Combobox value planes. Differs from the enabled value plane beyond text.

default.$description: Primary text. At least 7:1 on canvas and surface.

muted.$description: Secondary text. At least 4.5:1 on canvas and surface.

disabled.$description: Disabled labels only. Exempt from contrast minimums, so never use it for readable text.

field.$description: Resting edge of TextField, Select and Combobox. At least 3:1 on canvas and surface.

field-invalid.$description: Invalid field edge, never weaker than the resting edge. At least 3:1 on canvas and surface.

seal.$description: Su has one seal: a single color used only for the primary action and the current selection. Ink 墨 is the default; azurite 青 is the alternative, chosen with data-zao-seal="azurite". The accent roles alias the ink seal; theme.css swaps them for an azurite island.

solid.$description: The seal: the primary action, the current selection and focus marks that use the seal. Nothing else.

subtle.$description: Tinted backgrounds for the current selection.

border.$description: The edge of a filled seal part, such as an on Switch housing or a Progress face.

text.$description: Seal text and links. At least 4.5:1 on canvas and surface.

on.$description: Text and icons on the seal solid. At least 4.5:1.

subtle.$description: Tinted backgrounds for the current selection.

border.$description: The edge of a filled seal part, such as an on Switch housing or a Progress face.

text.$description: Seal text and links. At least 4.5:1 on canvas and surface.

on.$description: Text and icons on the seal solid. At least 4.5:1.

solid.$description: The seal solid: primary buttons and selected indicators. Aliases the active seal.

subtle.$description: Tinted backgrounds for selected or highlighted items.

text.$description: Links and accent text. At least 4.5:1 on canvas and surface.

ring.$description: Focus brackets and outlines, in ink (V1c). At least 3:1 against canvas and surface.

warning.$description: Needs attention, not yet a failure.
